summary: Live end-to-end verification of the Gemini 3 thought_signature fix using the real Gemini 3 Flash key (ai_active.source=gemini, model=gemini-3-flash-preview, health.ok=true; AI settings NOT modified, no bots started). API: POST /api/chat/message (crypto, BTCUSDT price) -> job done, assistant.error=false, tool get_market_context used. UI (1920x1080): login -> /hotforex chat (tools get_performance/get_signals/get_trades, ~8s), /bybit chat (get_logs/get_performance), /pepperstone chat (get_signals/get_logs), and multi-hop follow-up 'compara con el bot cripto' in the same shared conversation (get_performance/get_signals) — all returned valid answers, no chat-error-message, no chat-ai-down, no 'No pude responder' / 'thought_signature' text, tool badges shown, correct panel chip per bot. backend.err.log since test start: zero thought_signature/GeminiException/BadRequest entries; ai_health stays ok.

minor.issue: One 'asyncio - ERROR - Unclosed client session' line logged at 06:18:36 during the first Gemini turn — harmless resource-leak warning, not user-facing.

issues: Gemini often ends its reply with a literal '[Herramientas consultadas en esta respuesta: get_x, get_y]' line (3 of 5 answers), duplicating the wrench tool badge and exposing raw tool names. Root cause: chat/service.py:113 appends that suffix to stored assistant history, so the model imitates it. Consider moving it to a system note/instruction ('do not repeat this') or stripping the pattern from model output.

action_items: Optional: stop the model echoing '[Herramientas consultadas…]' in its answers (strip in post-processing or change how tools are annotated in history at chat/service.py:113).
Restore AI source settings afterwards as planned (left untouched by tester).
critical_code_review_comments: _keep_thought_signatures is defensive (try/except, no-op for non-Gemini) and correctly copies thinking_blocks + message/tool-call provider_specific_fields onto chat.messages[-1]; verified working live with litellm 1.80.0.

It relies on LlmChat internal history shape (chat.messages[-1] being the assistant tool_calls turn); a library upgrade could silently make it a no-op — the debug-level log would hide it. Consider logging at warning level when a Gemini response has tool_calls but no signature could be attached.
seed_data_creation: Added 5 user/assistant exchanges to the shared chat conversation (BTC price, HotForex diagnosis, Bybit logs, Pepperstone signals, crypto comparison).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Gemini 3 Flash answers with tools in ~6-10s. Chat is one shared conversation; only one job at a time (409 Busy). test_iter57_gemini_chat_live.py hits the real LLM (requires ai source gemini); test_iter63_gemini_thought_signature.py holds unit tests of the fix.
